name: Paw Print
line: A paw print in ink. Everyone has one.
hint: Everyone starts with this one.

name: Ledger Shell
line: A tiny shell with a line of writing.
hint: Find every page of The Tide Ledger.

name: Ash Feather
line: A feather, burnt at the tip.
hint: Find every page of The Ash Records.

name: Root Knot
line: A knot of root, tied tight.
hint: Find every page of Rootwork Notes.

name: Static Spark
line: A little blue spark that tickles.
hint: Find every page of Static Letters.

name: Signpost
line: A signpost with too many arrows.
hint: Find every page of The Signpost Series.

name: Crescent
line: A pale crescent, like a nail clipping of the moon.
hint: Find every page of Moonlit Verses.

name: Peat Bubble
line: A bubble from the fen, just about to pop.
hint: Find every page of The Peat Notes.

name: Torn Page
line: A page with one corner torn off.
hint: Find every page of Lost Pages.

name: Colossus Wave
line: A wave as big as a house.
hint: Beat Tidal Colossus in a raid.

name: Wyrm Coil
line: A coil of scales, still warm.
hint: Beat Cinder Wyrm in a raid.

name: Thorn Crown
line: A crown of thorns with a flower in it.
hint: Beat Thornmother in a raid.

name: Storm Crown
line: A crown with a crack of lightning.
hint: Beat Storm Sovereign in a raid.

name: Bogback Moss
line: A tuft of moss from a very large back.
hint: Beat Old Bogback in a raid.

name: Deep Door
line: A door standing open on the dark.
hint: Go ten floors deep in the dungeon.

name: Gold Medal
line: A gold medal on a ribbon.
hint: Win gold at the Valley Games.

name: Wayfarer
line: A boot print from every road.
hint: Visit seven different places.

name: Glimmer Star
line: A star that only shines on some.
hint: Find a shiny creature.

name: Housewarming
line: A small house with smoke from the chimney.
hint: Build the Cottage.

name: Matched Set
line: Two chairs that match.
hint: Finish a furniture set.

name: Old Coin
line: An old coin with a worn face.
hint: A rare find after a raid.

name: Lantern Key
line: A key on a lantern ring.
hint: A rare find at the end of a dungeon run.

name: Pressed Flower
line: A flower, pressed flat.
hint: A rare find on trips and scouts.

name: Rosette
line: A ribbon rosette.
hint: A rare find at the Valley Games.
